# Closure Report Acceptance Criteria
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

The report is usable only when every applicable criterion below is `Pass`. A `Partial` or `Fail` result blocks the quality gate. A `Not Applicable` result requires a reason.

| ID | Criterion |
|---|---|
| AC-01 | Project name, closure scope, and closure date are stated or explicitly marked pending with an owner and next action. |
| AC-02 | The reason for closure is documented with supporting evidence. |
| AC-03 | Final deliverables and their acceptance status are recorded. |
| AC-04 | Final scope, schedule, cost, and quality status are summarized with evidence or an explained N/A. |
| AC-05 | Each outstanding item has an owner, next action, target date, and handoff status, or the report states that no open items remain. |
| AC-06 | Handover or transition status identifies the receiving owner, destination, or justified N/A. |
| AC-07 | Key lessons learned are captured and usable for future work. |
| AC-08 | Administrative and contractual closure status is documented, including a reason for any N/A. |
| AC-09 | Required approval or signature records include the role, person, status, date, and evidence or a clear pending reason. Names alone do not count as approval evidence. |
| AC-10 | The report is stored in the agreed project repository, and the repository path is supported by project evidence. |
| AC-11 | The writing is concise, contains no filler or repetition, and leads with the closure result. |
